name: Money & Finances
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality and significance of material wealth, as seen in Abram's abundance of cattle, silver, and gold, and the challenges that come with great possessions, such as the inability of the land to support both Abram and Lot's substantial flocks and herds. The passages also highlight the practical use of money in family and covenant contexts, where individuals born or bought with money were integrated into Abraham's household and covenant through circumcision. These verses underscore that financial resources are part of God's provision and relational dealings, calling believers to recognize both the blessings and responsibilities tied to wealth.
